summary: Frontend-only validation completed on preview URL for Metro Motors local UI phase. Verified: sidebar theme/routes, no /api traffic on active routes, dashboard 3-card layout, core 6-step wizard validations, save-to-detail flow, unknown ID handling, deals search/filter/reset, metric deep links, delete confirm/cancel, and responsive overflow checks at 320/768/1024/1440. Remaining gap: full photo slot E2E persistence was not fully completed in automation due repeated hidden-input selector handling issues in test scripts.

ui_bugs.issue: Observed once during row action run: deals message showed runtime text 'Cannot read properties of null (reading 'id')' after delete interactions. Could not deterministically reproduce in follow-up runs (flaky).

action_items: Investigate flaky delete-message null-id runtime text in FunctionalDeals remove dialog path (likely state timing around deleting object lifecycle).
Run a dedicated stable Playwright test for all 32 photo slots (upload/preview/replace/remove/persist/reload) using set_input_files directly on hidden inputs without visibility waits.
Add explicit regression test for bill sequence behavior across delete + concurrent new-deal tabs (UI-level confirmation), though adapter logic appears correct by code review.
critical_code_review_comments: Active routed UI is correctly local/browser-only; routes use FunctionalDashboard/FunctionalDeals/FunctionalNewDeal/DealView + LocalBills/LocalFinances and do not call metroApi.
browserDealAdapter save transaction preserves bill_number/created_at on edit and uses year-prefixed sequence record in same transaction (good base for non-reuse and concurrency safety).
FunctionalDeals remove() depends on stateful deleting object; intermittent null-id message observed once suggests potential race between dialog close and onConfirm state usage.
App.js remains highly condensed in large single-line JSX blocks, which increases maintenance risk for future wizard or routing changes.

success_rate.frontend: ~82% of requested scope verified in execution; photo E2E and concurrency sequencing remain partially unverified

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_* local deals via UI during verification; final cleanup executed by IndexedDB purge of TEST records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed no /api calls while traversing 7 sidebar routes and core wizard/deals flows work. Sold status requirements (sold date, buyer, selling price) are enforced. Unknown /deals/:id shows browser-local error. Responsive overflow checks passed on sampled routes. Need focused rerun only for photo slot full matrix and potential flaky delete-message null-id issue.
rca of the issue:
Flaky issue observed once: after delete interactions, UI surfaced 'Cannot read properties of null (reading id)' in deals message. Likely scenario: delete action references deleting.id when deleting state becomes null due dialog lifecycle timing; not consistently reproducible. Suggested mitigation: capture deleting object in local const before async remove, and guard null before dereference.

MOCKED/LOCAL integrations: ALL active deal persistence and bill numbering are browser-local IndexedDB only; no real backend/auth/cloud storage is used in this phase.
